text: Entry Requirements 1 Applicants must be in good physical and mental health, possess the required academic qualifications, and meet the language proficiency requirements. 2 CSCA subjects requirements: Mathematics. 3 Applicants must hold a high school diploma or equivalent to the Chinese high school level and be non-Chinese citizens with a valid foreign passport. Language requirements: For English-taught programs, applicants musthave an IELTS score of 5.0, a TOEFL score of 60 or above, or pass an English interview conducted by telephone. Applicants who completed their previous education in English-speaking regions with English as the teaching language, are generally exempt from providing English language certificates.
